BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM – THEFT DETERRENT AND DOOR LOCK CONTROL SYSTEM

INSPECTION PROCEDURE
HINT: This troubleshooting is based on the premise that engine cranking occurs.
    If the engine does not crank, proceed to engine troubleshooting on page EG–381 or 487 (Vol. 1).

1  Check voltage between terminal SRLY of theft deterrent and door lock ECU connector and body ground.

         (See BO section.)
   (2)  Disconnect the ECU connector.

C  Measure voltage between terminal SRLY of theft deterrent ECU connector and body ground when ignition switch is turned on.

OK  Voltage: 10 – 14 V
